2005 SGIM official v1 JATS and 255-page PDF have identical 907 unique tracking IDs after PDF line-wrap normalization; all pages text-bearing. Tracking 134053 uses apple and orange in a stroke-related naming error, not food intake; separate tremor cases do not assign apple.

2017 SGIM official v2 full JATS and 726-page PDF have identical 1,596 unique control IDs after PDF line-wrap and hyphen normalization; all pages have text. Apple occurs as a surname, Apple devices, an iTunes link, and apple-green biopsy staining in distinct members, not raw apple exposure with Parkinson rest tremor.

2001 SGIM official v1 PDF has 211 continuous original pages S23–S233, all text-bearing; four section transitions and opening/closing abstracts checked against full JATS. The only apple hit is an apple-core bowel-imaging description on PDF page 29, while PD/rest tremor is discussed in other members; no raw apple exposure and PD resting-tremor comparison appears in the recovered collection.

2017 ACBICON original PDF has 239 text-bearing pages, each bearing its corresponding continuous printed S1–S239 number. P140 studies fresh apple in 25 healthy volunteers with antioxidant and laboratory safety outcomes; P141 is an orange study with an inconsistent apple baseline label. Neither studies PD resting tremor; no independent complete member inventory is available.

2021 SGIM official PDF has 469 text-bearing pages with continuous printed S1–S469 labels. All eight Apple mentions refer to digital stores, podcasts, a watch, or amyloid staining in distinct named control-ID members; none is raw fruit intake with Parkinson resting tremor. Official XML is front matter, so no independently reconciled member-ID inventory is claimed.

2022 SGIM official PDF contains 536 text-bearing pages with matching consecutive printed S129–S664 labels. Apple hits concern Siri (3710997), apple-cider vinegar dietary history (3692566), apple-picking outdoor history (3711089), and podcast URL (3709633), each separate from Parkinson rest-tremor comparison. Independent complete member-ID inventory is unavailable because XML is front matter.

2021 European geriatric congress official PDF spans 387 text-bearing pages; 386 show matching S-page numbers and the unnumbered PDF page 71 continues p70 text before p72. Contents identify oral, late-breaking and poster sections. The sole apple hit is an Apple iOS phone used for noise measurement in abstract 536, not fruit intake or PD rest tremor; no independent member inventory is available.

2017 ACBICON complete 239-page text-bearing PDF has matching printed S1–S239 labels. The two Turkey mentions in IL-75 and IL-77 (S50–S51) identify a geographic affiliation and concern cardiovascular biomarkers or cancer diagnostics; poultry and Meleagris are not reported. Parkinson models elsewhere are separate members, with no baked turkey/rest-tremor comparison.

The complete 2017 ACBICON PDF member FP44 (S84–S85) compares oxidation in four stored oils including olive oil; it has chemical endpoints and no human Parkinson resting-tremor comparison. The Parkinson model posters are separate members; independent member inventory and supplements remain unavailable.
